name: cost-pair
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile && d=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT && T13_FRESH_SAMPLES=1 bun research/track-gen/t13-generation.ts mldr > "$d/before" && bun research/track-gen/t13-generation.ts mldr > "$d/after" && bun research/track-gen/t13-compare.ts "$d/before" "$d/after"
